none: PAS HAMP-698B53: Roman coin : nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Hampshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337), dating to the period AD 321-323 (Reece period 16). BEATA TRAN-QVILLITAS reverse type depicting a globe on an altar inscribed VOT/TIS/XX, three stars above. Uncertain mint. The inscription on the altar appears to have an error, possibly reading VOT/TIS rather than VOT/IS or VO/TIS
